fractions.js:FX.title: ½ Fractions
fractions.js:FX.module_d: parts of a whole, Norwegian names and a test
fractions.js:FX.intro: A fraction is a part of a whole: a pizza cut into 4 slices, you ate 3 — that is 3/4, in Norwegian “tre fjerdedeler”. Tap anything to hear it in Norwegian.
fractions.js:FX.what_d: The bottom number (nevner — denominator) says into how many equal parts the whole is cut. The top number (teller — numerator) says how many parts you take. Between them is the brøkstrek, the fraction bar.
fractions.js:FX.nevner: nevner — denominator: equal parts in the whole
fractions.js:FX.build_d: Change the numbers to see the fraction on a pizza and a bar and hear its name.
fractions.js:FX.names_d: Most names are the ordinal number + “-del”: tredjedel, fjerdedel… Exceptions: en halv (1/2) and en tidel (1/10). For more than one part use “-deler”: to tredjedeler.
fractions.js:FX.eq_d: Different numbers, the same amount: 1/2 = 2/4 = 3/6 = 4/8 = 5/10. Compare the coloured bars.
fractions.js:FX.of_d: To find 1/3 of 12, split 12 into 3 equal groups — each group has 4. And 2/3 is two such groups, so 8.
fractions.js:FX.test_d: 10 tasks: pictures, names, comparing and a fraction of a number.
fractions.js:FX.q_name: How do you say it in Norwegian?
fractions.js:FX.q_eq: Which fraction is equal to this?

install.js:P.exe_full_d: Every comic, all audio and all tests go onto your disk. Works with no internet at all.
exe_steps: Press the button — the file goes to your Downloads.
Open it. Windows may warn about an unknown publisher: “More info” → “Run anyway”.
Keep “Shortcut on the desktop” ticked and press Install.
install.js:P.exe_warn: The installer asks for no administrator rights and installs into your own user folder. Remove it like any program, through Settings → Apps.
install.js:P.exe_ss_t: ⚠️ If Windows shows a blue window
install.js:P.exe_ss: “Windows protected your PC” appears for every program that few people have downloaded yet — it is not about viruses. Click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
install.js:P.exe_ss2: The warning goes away on its own once enough people install the app. Removing it earlier takes an expensive certificate issued to a registered company — we are not there yet, and we would rather not pretend otherwise.
install.js:P.exe_ss3: If you want no warnings at all, use the “Install the app” button at the top of this page: the shortcut is the same, but the browser puts it there itself.
install.js:P.apk_d: If you would rather not install from the browser, here is the real app as a single file. No Google Play needed.
install.js:P.apk_light_d: Eight stories and ten word themes inside, the rest loads from the site. Includes account, friends and ranking.
install.js:P.apk_full_d: Every comic, all audio and all tests inside. Works with no internet at all; no account.
apk_steps: Press the button — the file goes to your Downloads.
Open it. Android will ask for permission to install from this source — allow it.
install.js:P.apk_warn: The app is signed by us and has no ads. Android warns that the source is not Google Play — that is normal for APK files.
install.js:P.done: ✅ The app is already installed — you are running it in its own window.

kodegame.js:T.title: 🤖 Robo learns to code
kodegame.js:T.lead: Build a program from blocks and Robo runs it step by step. Collect code bits 💎, reach the charger ⚡ and earn stars for the shortest program. Your progress is saved.
kodegame.js:T.hint_edit: Tap a block in the program to remove it. Tap 🔁 to put blocks inside the loop; tap the number to change it.
kodegame.js:T.max: Too many blocks for this level.
kodegame.js:T.example_note: Code runs from left to right — one command per step.

koding.js:T.title: 💻 Coding for kids
koding.js:T.intro: Comics with Robo the robot and tests where you steer a robot, read tiny programs, build algorithms and hunt for bugs. Everything is in Norwegian — hover for a translation.
koding.js:T.what: Coding means giving a computer exact commands. A program is commands in the right order. The computer does not guess what we meant: it does exactly what is written.
koding.js:T.langs_t: Programming languages: what is each for?
koding.js:T.t_html: 🌐 HTML: what will the page look like?
koding.js:T.tip: Tip for parents and teachers: read a comic first, then take that comic’s test, and finish with “Everything”.

koding.js:HX.game_d: Build a program from blocks and the robot walks the maze. 17 levels: commands, loops, functions, bugs and a master test.
koding.js:HX.path_d: Each comic is a step: read the story and pass its test. Green means done.

learn-dash.js:L.title: 📊 My learning
learn-dash.js:L.sub: How your learning is going: results, effectiveness, words and mistakes. Compared with the previous period of the same length.
learn-dash.js:L.chart_d: Bars — number of quizzes, line — average accuracy.
learn-dash.js:L.cal_d: Active days over 17 weeks — the darker, the more quizzes.
learn-dash.js:L.areas_d: Average accuracy and number of attempts per section in the period.
learn-dash.js:L.none_area: No quizzes in this period yet.
learn-dash.js:L.words_d: Where your words are in spaced repetition.
learn-dash.js:L.errs_d: A mistake counts as fixed after correct answers today, a day later and 3 days later.
learn-dash.js:L.none: No quizzes yet — take any one and the charts will appear here.
learn-dash.js:L.t_streak0: Start a streak: one quiz a day and the calendar fills up.
learn-dash.js:L.t_good: Great pace! Try a quiz at the next level.

patterns: Discover the rule and continue a row of symbols or numbers.

math.js:MX.title: 🧮 Maths in Norwegian
math.js:MX.intro: Count and learn numbers at the same time: every sum is read aloud in Norwegian (“tre ganger fire er tolv”). Times tables with pictures, a trainer and a space speed game.
math.js:MX.table_hint: Tap a cell to see a picture and hear the sum in Norwegian.
math.js:MX.rocket_intro: A 60-second space game: solve sums and shoot the asteroid with the right answer. A mistake costs 3 seconds.

teacher.js:T.lead: Learning on the site is free for everyone. A teacher account adds tools for the class: QR-code tournaments, wider limits on the speaking exercises and invitations for colleagues. You only need to confirm that you teach.
li: 📝 Unlimited tests for you and your class
🏁 Class tournaments: Logic Race, Math Rocket, chess with a QR code

how_li: a link to the school page that shows your name;
a photo of your staff card or badge (you may cover private details);
a timetable, a school email address, a letter from the administration;
